data.exact_reserve_text: In the calendar year there was a prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $10.5m, (2015: $1.1m favourable).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at 1 January 2016 were $133.625m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year adverse development of approximately $21.18m (about 15.9% of opening gross reserves), driven principally by adverse development on older accident years (notably the 2014 column) and an increase in discrete/large losses and attritional claims in 2016. The movement was quantified from the published gross claims development triangle as the report does not provide a single explicit gross prior-year movement figure in the technical movement note.
raw_causal_phrases: prior accident year adverse development of claims incurred of $10.5m, (2015: $1.1m favourable).
the claims ratio was hit by a number of discrete losses and an increase in attritional claims in the year.
an increase in discrete and non-correlated large risk losses in the second half of 2016
data.data_quality_notes: Opening and movement figures extracted from the Technical Provisions note and Gross Claims Development Triangle. The report is denominated in USD ($'000); all monetary values converted to millions USD. No explicit single gross 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure was published, so the prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle per the instructions. The 'exact_reserve_text' sentence in the report refers to 'claims incurred' (P&L concept) rather than a gross reserve movement - included verbatim for context, but the PYD number above was derived from the gross triangle.
